Package arztis.econnector.ihe.parameters

Class SearchParameter

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.model.Parameter
arztis.econnector.ihe.parameters.SearchParameter
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class SearchParameter
extends Parameter
This class is used to pass details to restrict the search. It can be used for different use cases, such as for example to query documents for a patient or query documents with a specific id.
Author:
ET-Innovations

  • Constructor Details

    • SearchParameter

      public SearchParameter()
      Default constructor to create an instance of SearchParameter. This constructor assigns an empty List to the documentId.

  • Method Details

    • getStatus

      public java.lang.String getStatus()
      Status of the document. Possible values are deprecated or approved. The status "deprecated" indicates that the document is invalid or has been cancelled.
      Returns:
      status

    • getDocumentId

      public java.util.List<java.lang.String> getDocumentId()
      List of document IDs, for example eMed-IDs of prescriptions. These IDs can be used to get only documents with these IDs in a search.
      Returns:
      list of IDs

    • getMetadata

      public arztis.econnector.ihe.documents.ELGADocumentMetadata getMetadata()
      Metadata (ELGADocumentMetadata) of a document. There are different metadata for ELGA like the practice setting code or the creation time of a document. This metadata can be used to restrict the search for documents.
      Returns:
      metadata

    • isForceReload

      public boolean isForceReload()
      Specifies whether the query is to be executed again. This parameter is only needed if an additional cache is implemented. Therefore it is not used in the ELGA reference client.
      Returns:
      true if the documents should be reloaded, otherwise false

    • getVirtualOrganizationId

      public arztis.econnector.ihe.utilities.ElgaEHealthApplication getVirtualOrganizationId()
      Id of the eHealth application for a virtual organization. This parameter restricts the search to one virtual organization. For example, only documents in the PVN Lammertal are searched.
      Returns:
      Id of the eHealth application for a virtual organization

    • isRequestDocumentsExsits

      public boolean isRequestDocumentsExsits()
      Specifies whether the query should only return whether documents exists or not. This parameter is only needed if an additional request is implemented, which should check if documents existing. Therefore it is not used in the ELGA reference client.
      Returns:
      true if the request should check if documents exists, otherwise false
